+"""Record preparation steps reusing pytest helpers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+from typing import Callable
+
+from _pytest.compat import is_async_function
+
+
+def prepare_record(
+    record: object, render: Callable[[Any], Any]
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Validate ``record`` and return a new dict with ``display = render(value)``.
+
+    ``record`` must be a dict with a nonempty (after trimming) string ``key``
+    and a ``value`` entry; ``enabled`` defaults to True and must be a bool.
+    The input is never mutated.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(record, dict):
+        raise ValueError("record must be a dict")
+    key = record.get("key")
+    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
+        raise ValueError("record key must be a nonempty string")
+    if "value" not in record:
+        raise ValueError("record must have a value")
+    enabled = record.get("enabled", True)
+    if not isinstance(enabled, bool):
+        raise ValueError("record enabled must be a bool")
+    value = record["value"]
+    return {
+        "key": key.strip(),
+        "value": value,
+        "display": render(value),
+        "enabled": enabled,
+    }
+
+
+def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
+    """Whether ``value`` is a coroutine function or async generator function."""
+    return is_async_function(value)
+
+
+def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    return prepare_record(record, display_async)

@@ -43,3 +43,18 @@ def display_async(value: object) -> bool:
 
 def prepare(record: object) -> dict[str, Any]:
     return prepare_record(record, display_async)
+
+
+def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    """Prepare each record in order; duplicate trimmed keys raise ValueError."""
+    if not isinstance(records, list):
+        raise ValueError("records must be a list")
+    prepared: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    seen: set[str] = set()
+    for record in records:
+        item = prepare(record)
+        if item["key"] in seen:
+            raise ValueError('duplicate key: ' + repr(item['key']))
+        seen.add(item["key"])
+        prepared.append(item)
+    return prepared

@@ -58,3 +58,12 @@ def batch(records: object) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
         seen.add(item["key"])
         prepared.append(item)
     return prepared
+
+
+def group(records: object) -> dict[str, list[Any]]:
+    """Map the first character of each enabled key to its display values."""
+    grouped: dict[str, list[Any]] = {}
+    for item in batch(records):
+        if item["enabled"]:
+            grouped.setdefault(item["key"][0], []).append(item["display"])
+    return grouped
